_comment_1: Deployment campaign Phase 2. Every external root the test corpus depends on, declared ONCE.
_comment_2: Before this file, these values were spelled out ~389 times across 243 test JSONs, which is why a machine without C:\Repos could not run tests it had been shipped.
_comment_3: OVERRIDE ANY ENTRY WITH AN ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE OF THE SAME NAME - that is how a QC machine repoints one root without editing content it did not author.
_comment_4: An unset token is left visible in the path rather than blanked, and `canary doctor` names it. A path that silently resolved to nothing would fail far from the cause.
_comment_6: Adjacent, outside MultiVerse governance but referenced by cpig geometry-import tests. Found by the corpus guard, not by the original census - the census pattern missed JSON-escaped backslashes.
_comment_5: Cross-product handoff on Google Drive. Sync fights byte-locks and mtimes, so nothing should WRITE here during a run - it is a delivery location, not a runtime one.
_comment_7: The Rhino 8 INSTALL ROOT, not the exe - content appends /System/Rhino.exe itself. Root because that is the one thing that moves between machines; the layout under it is Rhino's, not ours. Before this the path was written out twice in workloads/rhino/workload.json (appPath and a kind:file requirement), so a machine with Rhino anywhere else failed twice for one reason, and neither failure could be fixed without editing shipped content.
